name: Shikimi
source:
Two girl classmates stay at school after classes. But they aren't going to study. They are in love with each other and dedicate this time only to themselves.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/07/vn-of-month-december-1995.html]vndbreview[/url]]
